Control methods are divided by whether the policy outputs base velocity or joints directly, or outputs waypoints, discrete actions, or velocity commands executed by a low-level controller (PD, MPC, RL locomotion policy). Applies SFT to a general VLM (Qwen2-VL) for egocentric-video-based VLN, then improves multi-step action prediction via GRPO reinforcement fine-tuning (RFT) with a time-decayed reward (TDR).
